verificationPaths: Founder Verified confirms identity and account control through the founding administrator. Identity Verified requires approval from two eligible independent reviewers.
supersessionExplanation: If granted, Founder Verified has different privileges from independently reviewed identity. You can close your pending identity application and keep its history, or leave it open for independent review.
supersessionChoice: Close this pending application if Founder Verified is granted.
supersessionAgreed: Member agreed to close this application.
supersessionNotAgreed: Member has not agreed to close this application.
supersessionReady: The current application can be closed when the Founder designation is granted.
supersededMemberNotice: Your previous identity verification application was closed because you accepted Founder Verified. It was not independently approved.

supersessionResults.no_consent: The application was kept open or no eligible application was present.
supersessionResults.superseded_by_founder_verification: Superseded by Founder Verified with the member’s consent.
supersessionResults.application_completed: The application already received a decision.
supersessionResults.stale_application: The application or its review changed after consent.
supersessionResults.application_held: An active hold prevents closing this application.

founderIssuanceOnly: Only the Founder can issue this designation after all verification requirements are met.
bootstrapHelp: Enter the private one-time credential issued for your confirmed email. A recent authenticator check is required.
bootstrapUnavailable: Founder setup could not be completed. Check the credential or contact the installation operator.
reviewAccessRequired: Reviewing Founder Verified cases requires an active Founder Identity reviewer assignment.
openHelp: Enter a username to open a consent request. The member can respond from Verification without submitting an application.
title: Founder identity
badgeMeaning: Ayinou’s founding administrator confirmed this member’s identity and control of their Ayinou account.
disabled: Founder Verified issuance is closed. An approved identity and account-control process is required before any designation can be issued.
notDeployed: Founder identity is unavailable until its database migration is applied.
noAssigned: No cases are assigned to your founder authority.
noConflict: I have no conflict of interest in this case.
publicChoice: Show the designation on my public profile if granted
consentExplanation: I agree to Founder Verified identity and account-control review under policy version {version}. Public display is optional. I can withdraw this consent.
correctionPending: Your correction request is pending. A reviewer independent of the earlier decision must handle it.

reasons.confirmed: Identity and control were confirmed through the approved process.
reasons.insufficient_proof: The required identity or account-control evidence is incomplete.
reasons.conflict: A conflict prevents this reviewer from making a decision.
reasons.account_risk: An account or identity concern requires this action.

prompts.supersede: Confirm closing this pending application because you accepted Founder Verified. Its history will be preserved and its independent review will end.
prompts.consent: Confirm your choice to proceed with this founder review.
prompts.withdraw: Withdraw your consent and remove any public Founder Verified designation?
prompts.correction: Request independent review of this decision?

liveProof.attestation: I confirmed this person’s identity with the selected method, matched it to the confirmed Ayinou account, and have no material conflict.
liveProof.authenticatorHelp: Enter a fresh code from the authenticator registered to your Ayinou account. If you have no authenticator yet, add one in Account settings.
liveProof.authenticatorFailed: The authenticator check could not be completed. Check your code and registered authenticator, then try again.
